title: Matchday 1 — USA Open Loud, Canada Settle

slides.hook: Four goals, one *red*, and a finish after the whistle.

slides.headline: An own goal cracks it *open* early
slides.body: Bobadilla turns it into his own net at 7'. Then Balogun takes over. Pulisic sets up the second at 31'; Tillman the third in stoppage time. Halftime read 3-0, *settled*.

slides.headline: A red card barely *dents* the lead
slides.body: Tim Ream sees red at 52'. Paraguay smell a comeback — Maurício answers Enciso at 73'. It fades fast. Reyna, fed by Freeman, makes it four at 90'+8'. *Filed*.

slides.context: Bosnia's Lukic struck first at 21' off Kolasinac. Larin equalized at 78', Promise David assisting. Five yellows, a clean *split* of points.

slides.note: Tomorrow: Qatar vs Switzerland, Brazil vs Morocco & 2 more.

stories.big: Three up at the break, ten men after 52'. The board *held*.

stories.note: One own, two from Balogun, one from Reyna after the whistle. ...under protest.
